Hockey prodigy Liam returns after a match-fixing scandal. Forced to live with high-school rival Mateo for a PR campaign, old feelings resurface. When the mob returns, Mateo breaks his ankle protecting Liam—and after a semifinal miracle, kisses him on live TV.
冰球天才 Liam 在卷入假球操纵丑闻后回归赛场。为配合一场公关造势，他被迫与高中时代的死对头 Mateo 同住一个屋檐下，尘封已久的旧情悄然浮动。当黑帮势力再次找上门时，Mateo 为保护 Liam 而摔断了脚踝——半决赛奇迹逆转之后，他在电视直播镜头前吻了 Liam。
